{"program":"domain(person,[griffin,juliette,opal,sapphire]).
% Griffin values stability.
axiom(s1,values_stability(griffin)).
% If Juliette rebels against norms, then she is a free-spirited artist or creates innovative work.
axiom(s2,rule([rebels_against_norms(juliette)],or(free_spirited_artist(juliette),creates_innovative_work(juliette)))).
% If Opal takes risks, then she either pursues her passion or expresses a unique perspective (or both).
axiom(s3,rule([takes_risks(opal)],or(pursues_passion(opal),expresses_unique_perspective(opal)))).
% Opal does not defy conventions.
axiom(s4,not(defies_conventions(opal))).
% Juliette has unconventional tastes.
axiom(s5,has_unconventional_tastes(juliette)).
% If Juliette takes risks, then she either pursues her passion or expresses a unique perspective (or both).
axiom(s6,rule([takes_risks(juliette)],or(pursues_passion(juliette),expresses_unique_perspective(juliette)))).
% If someone either has unconventional tastes or disregards criticism (but not both), then they take risks.
axiom(s7,rule([xor(has_unconventional_tastes(X),disregards_criticism(X))],takes_risks(X))).
% If Juliette either follows her intuition or embraces uncertainty (but not both), then she pursues her passion.
axiom(s8,rule([xor(follows_intuition(juliette),embraces_uncertainty(juliette))],pursues_passion(juliette))).
% For Opal, pursuing passion and valuing stability are mutually exclusive.
axiom(s9,xor(pursues_passion(opal),values_stability(opal))).
% If Opal has confidence, then she breaks rules and thinks outside the box.
axiom(s10,rule([has_confidence(opal)],and(breaks_rules(opal),thinks_outside_the_box(opal)))).
% If Juliette has confidence, then she breaks rules and thinks outside the box.
axiom(s11,rule([has_confidence(juliette)],and(breaks_rules(juliette),thinks_outside_the_box(juliette)))).
% For Juliette, pursuing passion and valuing stability are mutually exclusive.
axiom(s12,xor(pursues_passion(juliette),values_stability(juliette))).
% Juliette does not defy conventions.
axiom(s13,not(defies_conventions(juliette))).
% Juliette values stability.
axiom(s14,values_stability(juliette)).
% Sapphire has confidence.
axiom(s15,has_confidence(sapphire)).
% Juliette does not create innovative work.
axiom(s16,not(creates_innovative_work(juliette))).
% Opal does not disregard criticism.
axiom(s17,not(disregards_criticism(opal))).
% If Opal either defies conventions or breaks rules (but not both), then she rebels against norms.
axiom(s18,rule([xor(defies_conventions(opal),breaks_rules(opal))],rebels_against_norms(opal))).
% If Juliette either defies conventions or breaks rules (but not both), then she rebels against norms.
axiom(s19,rule([xor(defies_conventions(juliette),breaks_rules(juliette))],rebels_against_norms(juliette))).
% Juliette does not disregard criticism.
axiom(s20,not(disregards_criticism(juliette))).
% For all humans, if someone is a free-spirited artist, then they express a unique perspective and inspire others.
axiom(s21,forall(var(x,person),rule([free_spirited_artist(var(x))],and(expresses_unique_perspective(var(x)),inspires_others(var(x)))))).
% All individuals with vibrant imagination express a unique perspective and bring emotional depth to their work.
axiom(s22,forall(var(x,person),rule([has_vibrant_imagination(var(x))],and(expresses_unique_perspective(var(x)),brings_emotional_depth_to_their_work(var(x)))))).","query":"labelled_explanation(inspires_others(juliette), Status, Package)"}
